evidence.text:
git add -A && git config user.name "openhands" && git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev" && git commit -m "Fix overlapping auto-closing pairs: avoid duplicating closing characters when pairs conflict

When typing multi-character open sequences whose close overlaps with an existing auto-inserted closing bracket (e.g. '(' ... ')' and '(*' ... '*)'), do not insert the closing sequence if it would duplicate already-present characters. This prevents cases like typing '(*' producing '**))'.

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
